brief: Identify records needed to substantiate a fictional income or expense declaration.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Tax Evidence"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Conserva pruebas del dato"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Guarde provas do dado"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Identify records needed to substantiate a fictional income or expense declaration.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A clear record helps explain where a declared amount came from.
instruction.misconception: A remembered estimate or invented receipt is equivalent to evidence supporting a declaration.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Keep the dated receipt and payment proof for this fictional declaration. Together they connect the expense to the event.
The documents connect the expense and completed payment.
A complete receipt record supports the period’s income total.
Correct amounts still need the relevant dates and context.
Missing evidence calls for recovery or clarification, not fabrication.
Proof of payment does not establish every tax treatment.
The evidence explains both the receipt and why it was corrected.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
